A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Asparagus** (≈25 min).  
- 2 chicken breasts, pounded thin  
- 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed  
- 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 garlic cloves (minced), zest/juice of 1 lemon  
- Salt, pepper, red-pepper flakes  
Sear chicken 3–4 min/side, remove. Toss asparagus in same pan 4 min. Return chicken, add garlic 30 s, finish with lemon juice/zest. Serve with microwave rice or crusty bread.

PLAN: Ask if they want the full written recipe card or a shopping list for the ingredients.  
PLAN: Offer to set a 25-minute timer or add the recipe to their meal-plan calendar.  
PLAN: Suggest easy swaps (tofu, shrimp, broccoli) if they have dietary preferences.
